purpose: Compile the exact browser compound goal after URL-path and future-output repairs.

steps.command:
set -euo pipefail
python - <<'PY'
import importlib.util,json,pathlib,sys
root=pathlib.Path('.').resolve(); p=pathlib.Path('canonical/runtime/goal_compiler.py')
s=importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('g3',p); g=importlib.util.module_from_spec(s); sys.modules[s.name]=g; s.loader.exec_module(g)
reg=json.loads(pathlib.Path('canonical/runtime/BOUND_CAPABILITY_REGISTRY_V1.json').read_text())['capabilities']
goal=("Using a real rendered browser, open https://www.python.org/downloads/. Determine the latest stable Python 3 release shown on the page. "
"Save a full-page screenshot to canonical/astra_runtime/tmp/PYTHON_DOWNLOADS.png and save canonical/astra_runtime/tmp/PYTHON_DOWNLOADS_RESULT.json containing source_url, final_url, page_title, latest_stable_python3, and observed_text_evidence. "
"Finally independently verify from the official Python downloads page, without trusting the browser extraction, that the claimed latest_stable_python3 string is present and corresponds to the current stable Python 3 release shown there.")
try: print(json.dumps(g.compile_goal(goal,reg,root),sort_keys=True))
except Exception as e: print(type(e).__name__+":"+str(e))
print("BROWSER_COMPILE_DIAG3_COMPLETE")
PY
